name: fetchwright-setup
topic: Setting up a Gemini API key for a CLI: AI Studio keys and restrictions, environment variables, free and paid tiers, prices, rate limits and error codes, free-tier data use, age and regional rules, model lifecycle

volatile_claims.claim: New AI Studio keys are restricted to the Gemini API; unrestricted standard keys are rejected (api-key page, 2026-10-06)
gemini-3.8-flash paid: $0.75 in, $3.75 out per 1M tokens to 2026-12-31, then $1.50 and $7.50; gemini-3.5-flash-lite $0.30 and $2.50 (pricing page, 2026-10-15)
Free-tier rate limits per model are shown only in AI Studio, not on the rate-limits page (2026-10-15)
Free tier: prompts and responses improve Google products and human reviewers may read them; paid: not used that way (terms effective 2026-03-23)
18+; only paid services may serve users in the EEA, Switzerland or the UK (terms effective 2026-03-23)
Tiers: Free, Tier 1 (billing linked), Tier 2 ($100 + 3 days), Tier 3 ($1,000 + 30 days); prepay from $5; 402 on an empty balance
Google SDKs prefer GOOGLE_API_KEY over GEMINI_API_KEY when both are set (api-key page, 2026-10-06)
